decisive_items: mass at the level of the left middle turbinate extending into the left nasal roof and eroding the upper nasal septum
no intratumoral hemorrhage or cystic change
response.rationale: The middle turbinate epicenter and mildly enhancing solid, non-cystic appearance favor inverted papilloma over esthesioneuroblastoma or mucocele; skull-base erosion with intact dura is compatible with locally aggressive inverted papilloma.

rejected.why: Mucocele would appear as a non-enhancing cystic sinus lesion, but the vignette describes an enhancing soft-tissue mass and explicitly notes no intratumoral cystic change on MRI.

Esthesioneuroblastoma is a reasonable differential due to superior nasal cavity/skull-base involvement, but the middle turbinate origin, mild enhancement, and lack of hemorrhage/cystic change are more characteristic of inverted papilloma.
